title: Yuushun: Classic Road
native_title: 優駿 クラシック・ロード
overview: Yuushun: Classic Road is a derby horse breeding and management simulation game and part of the Classic Road series. The player manages a stable of horses, breeding and training them, and entering them into races. The game offers the choice of any season from 1988 to 1996 including all the real-life horses active for each season, with the ultimate goal of winning the Classic to reach the prestigious G1 race. In addition to the campaign mode, there is also a competition mode for up to four players.
